series: Social Security automatic-determination COLA history by first payment year
year_semantics: calendar year in which payments reflecting the COLA begin

historical_timing.1975-1982: effective in June and first reflected in July payments of the named year
historical_timing.1983: transition year with no COLA; the next adjustment was first reflected in January 1984 payments
historical_timing.1984-2022: effective in December of the prior year and first reflected in January payments of the named year

provenance.source: Social Security Administration, Office of the Chief Actuary, Cost-of-Living Adjustments
provenance.vintage: History through first payment year 2022 (the 2021 determination); later live-page rows are intentionally outside this artifact's vintage.
provenance.transcription_method: Values manually transcribed into scripts/extract_ssa_cola_history.py; the build performs no network access.
provenance.transcription_verification: Offline transcription; no web fetch was performed for this implementation PR. The complete 1975-2022 transcription requires verification at implementation review against https://www.ssa.gov/oact/cola/colaseries.html.
provenance.content_hash_basis: sha256 of the UTF-8 canonical JSON encoding of the complete data object (sorted keys, compact separators, trailing newline)

build.reproducible: rendered deterministically from the pinned in-script transcription; no network or wall-clock timestamp is used
